idea-plugin.name: RWord
idea-plugin.description:
Browse your own vocabulary while coding. RWord shows one of your entries in Rider’s status bar.

Import English and Chinese yourself. The plugin does not translate online or upload your word list.

  • Previous and next, with the current position shown as 3/48.
  • Click the English word to hear it. On Windows, an en-US voice is used when available.
  • Auto reads the next word. Turn it off with the Auto switch.
  • EN+ shows English and Chinese; EN shows English only.
  • Got asks for confirmation, then moves the word to a copyable remembered list. Previous can bring it back with Undo.
  • Browse in list order or in a stable random order.

在 Rider 状态栏浏览你自己的词表。中文由你提供，插件不联网、不上传词表。

点击英文可发音；Auto 开启时，下一个单词会自动朗读。EN+ 同时显示中英文，EN 只显示英文。Got 经确认后把单词移入可复制的已记住列表，点上一个后可用 Undo 恢复。

Settings → RWord. One entry per line: English, then a tab or |, then Chinese.
